paper_title: Results of a Search for Paraphotons with Intense X-ray Beams at SPring-8
coupling_convention: photon-paraphoton kinetic mixing angle chi, dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 4
notes: X-ray light-shining-through-wall paraphoton search at SPring-8 BL19LXU. Final combined limit is mass-independent: chi < 8.06e-5 (95% C.L.) valid for 0.04 eV < m_gamma' < 26 keV, encoded as a two-point flat bound. The actual exclusion (Fig. 4) has oscillatory structure at low masses not captured here; the quoted flat value is the paper's conservative worst-case result.
